title: PIXIU: A Large Language Model, Instruction Data and Evaluation Benchmark for Finance

task.value: Building an open-source instruction-tuned financial LLM (FinMA), a financial instruction-tuning dataset (FIT), and an evaluation benchmark (FLARE) covering financial NLP and stock movement prediction.
task.quote: This paper introduces PIXIU, a comprehensive framework including the first financial LLM based on fine-tuning LLaMA with instruction data, the first instruction data with 136K data samples to support the fine-tuning, and an evaluation benchmark with 5 tasks and 9 datasets.

architecture.value: LLaMA fine-tuned with multi-task instruction data (instruction/text/response templates written by domain experts); FinMA-7B and 30B on NLP tasks only, FinMA-7B-full on all data; AdamW, batch 32, lr 8e-6, max length 2048.
architecture.quote: We train three models: FinMA-7B and FinMA-30B by fine-tuning LLaMA 7B and 30B checkpoint with instruction tuning data covering NLP tasks, and FinMA-7B-full by fine-tuning LLaMA 7B with full instruction tuning data .

data.value: Nine open datasets: FPB, FiQA-SA, Gold Headline, FIN NER, FinQA, ConvFinQA, and stock movement datasets BigData22, ACL18, CIKM18 (tweets plus historical prices); 136,609 instruction samples.
data.quote: Our contributions can be summarized as follows: 1) We introduce FIT, the first multi-task and multi-modal instruction tuning data in the financial domain, covering 5 tasks and 9 datasets with 136,609 (136K) data samples.

window.value: Validation and test sets randomly selected from FIT (e.g. ACL18 valid 2,554 / test 3,719); no test dates given.
window.quote: We randomly select validation sets from FIT to select the best model checkpoint, and test sets for evaluation.

models.value: LLaMA 7B and 30B as backbones for FinMA-7B, FinMA-30B, FinMA-7B-full.
models.quote: We fine-tune LLaMA-7B with 15 epochs and LLaAM-7B-full with 3 epochs based on AdamW optimizer (Loshchilov and Hutter, 2017).

baselines.value: BloombergGPT, GPT-4, ChatGPT, BLOOM, GPT-NeoX, OPT-66B, Vicuna-13B, in zero-shot or few-shot settings.
baselines.quote: We compare FinMA with following LLMs: 1) BloombergGPT (Wu et al., 2023).

headline_result.value: FinMA-30B outperforms GPT-4 by 10% F1 and BloombergGPT by 37% F1 on FPB; on ACL18 stock prediction FinMA-7B-full gets Acc 0.56, MCC 0.10.
headline_result.quote: For example, FinMA-30B outperforms GPT-4 by 10% F1 score, and BloombergGPT by 37% F1 score on the FPB dataset.

costs.value: Compute only: FinMA-7B fine-tuned on 8 A100 40GB GPUs; FinMA-30B on 128 A100 40GB GPUs. No trading costs.
costs.quote: Different from FinMA-7B, it can only be distributed fine-tuned on 128 A100 40GB GPUs.

limitations.value: Models only up to 30B, 30B not trained on full data; weak quantitative reasoning and stock prediction; reliance on handcrafted instructions and LLaMA input length; potential misuse.
limitations.quote: Model and Training Constraints: We only present FinMA models up to 30B. Due to computational constraints, FinMA-30B has not been fine-tuned on the full dataset.

release.value: Model, datasets, benchmark and results open-sourced at https://github.com/chancefocus/PIXIU.
release.quote: The model, datasets, benchmark, and experimental results are open-sourced 11 1 https://github.com/chancefocus/PIXIU to facilitate future research in financial AI.
